subject: Prod tail jitter & 5xx spike — NovaForma private cluster (urgent)
messages:
From: Aditi Rao <aditi@novaforma.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara.lin@novaforma.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production tail jitter and 504 spike on NovaForma VPC inference cluster

Vanessa —

We're seeing a serious regression in our private VPC deployment since ~07:45 PST: p95 latency jumped from ~220ms to ~1.6s, and we're getting a steady stream of 504/502s from the inference gateway. Throughput dropped ~40% (tokens/s), which is impacting billing and realtime billing reconciliation for our payments pipeline. Attached is a dashboard screenshot (novaforma_dashboard_spike.png) and a short kernel dmesg excerpt from node-3 (node3_dmesg_excerpt.txt).

Observations from our side:
- Spike aligns with a batch rebuild at 07:44 (scheduled nightly warmup)
- One of the nodes (node-3) shows repeated IO stall messages and a flurry of page reclaim activity
- KV cache hit-rate on our primary model dropped from 98% to ~60%

We need immediate triage. Can Redwood run a fallback to the previously pinned quantized variant? We have a maintenance window starting 11:30 PST if you need to do a canary. This is P1 for us (affecting live billing flows).

Please advise on next steps; looping in our CTO Sara.

Thanks,
Aditi Rao
Ops Lead — NovaForma
ops@novaforma.com

Attachments: novaforma_dashboard_spike.png, node3_dmesg_excerpt.txt

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Production tail jitter and 504 spike on NovaForma private cluster (triage notes)

Team — quick triage notes after looking at the dmesg and metrics:

1) Evidence of IO stalls on node-3 coincident with heavy page reclaim activity (see attached excerpt). That matches the drop in KV cache hit-rate and increased tail latency.
2) Node-3 shows NUMA imbalance; the inference process appears to be migrating across NUMA nodes during warmup, causing repeated cold cache misses and longer decode paths.
3) Runtime kernel (v1.14.1) shows a known preemption edge-case under bursty warmup — we have a kfix queued (v1.14.2-kfix) that reduces blocking in the worker thread and pins KV cache allocations to stable CPU sets.

Immediate mitigations I recommend (can be done during the canary window):
- Apply kernel/runtime flag: --pin-inference-threads=cpu-set-1 and set vm.swappiness=1 temporarily on node-3
- Disable nightly batch warmup for the cluster while we validate (quick config flip)
- Canary deploy runtime v1.14.2-kfix to node-3 only at 11:30 PST, monitor p50/p95/p99 and 5xx rate for 20m
- If the canary looks good, roll to the remaining nodes in 10m increments with KV cache warming disabled for the first minute to avoid synchronized rebuild storms.

I will prepare a one-page mutual_action_plan_novaforma.pdf and request CS to coordinate the change window with NovaForma. We may also need an exception to push the patch into the private control plane; Vanessa, can you confirm approval path with the account team / execs?

Vivek Kulkarni
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan_novaforma.pdf

Subject: Executive summary & request for emergency exception (NovaForma P1)

Rishi —

Quick executive summary for awareness and approval: NovaForma's private VPC is experiencing tail latency and 5xxs due to a node-level IO stall that triggers KV cache rebuild storms during warmup. Impact: live billing pipeline degradation; customer has classified P1 and is requesting remediation ASAP.

Proposed course (from infra):
- Canary runtime patch v1.14.2-kfix to node-3 at 11:30 PST (20m watch)
- If canary passes, rolling rollout in 10m steps with KV cache warming suppressed for first minute to avoid synchronized rebuilds
- Short rollback plan: revert to v1.14.1 and re-enable prior CPU affinities; expected rollback time < 8m

Request: Please approve an emergency exception to push v1.14.2-kfix into NovaForma's private control plane (this normally requires a 48h change window). Also advise on SLA credit authority for P1 incidents at this stage of the engagement (DEAL-8723).

Link to mutual action plan and HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/8723, https://drive.redwood/mutual_action_plan/DEAL-8723

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
